outfits.name: Conference Fit
outfits.description: Tech-conference staff outfit — purple polo shirt with a white logo on the chest and branded sneakers, paired with relaxed-fit beige chinos.

outfits.name: Festive Christmas dress
outfits.description: Knit red sweater-dress with off-the-shoulder white collar, long sleeves with wide white cuffs, and two small white buttons at the chest. A thin black belt cinches the waist, accented by a small white bow. The flared skirt has a wide white fluffy hem with a small holly leaf embroidery near the bottom right. White thigh-high stockings and brown lace-up boots complete the cozy holiday look.

outfits.name: Celestial gothic ensemble
outfits.description: Black dress with gold star-patterned embroidery and scalloped gold trim along the collar, skirt edges, and cuffs. Puffed short sleeves and a small bow at the collar. The dress features a front opening at the skirt revealing black shorts with a gold-buckled belt underneath. Black thigh-high stockings with gold garter straps, finished with sleek white knee-high boots accented with gold details. On the back, there are small black cute devil wings, and a black devil tail.
